base.prompt: Create a landscape black-and-white character model sheet of the girl in reference photos 1–4. Photos 1–4 are identity references of the SAME child; image 5 is ONLY the line-art style and sheet layout reference (mother-photo-based), do not copy the adult's face or age. Preserve this girl's recognizable features: softly rounded oval face with full cheeks, natural narrow almond-shaped dark eyes and gentle upper lids (not huge anime eyes), gently arched brows, small rounded nose, characteristic subtle closed-mouth smile and upper-teeth smile, straight dark hair. Use photo 1 as primary face/hair reference: side part, low twin braids, small barrette on her left temple (viewer right). Natural school-age child's proportions as in photos, no aging up and no toddler/chibi proportions. Clean fine expressive black ink outlines, selective fine hatching, dark hair with individual strand highlights, white background, matching the semi-realistic restrained illustrated character-design level of image 5. Same character consistently across a full-body relaxed standing view left, front/three-quarter/profile busts upper row, crouching looking down lower center, and three smaller expression portraits lower right: thoughtful, soft smile, delighted smile. One optional smaller glasses portrait uses the thin rounded glasses from photo 2; main views without glasses. Clothing consistent with photo 1: modest long-sleeve light sweatshirt with sparse tiny heart motifs, dark simple leggings and ordinary sneakers. No hats/scarves/bags or photo backgrounds. No text, names, labels, logos, watermarks. Keep age-appropriate natural facial likeness, avoid generic cute doll face. Full body uncropped with generous white space. This is a reusable character base, not a photographic collage.

warm.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the edit target: photo-based girl character sheet. Image 2 is the approved warm-pencil parent-child STYLE reference only. Transform image 1 into the exact warm children's picture-book rendering family of image 2. Preserve girl's own recognizable face, narrow almond eyes, rounded cheeks, natural smile, age, side-parted dark hair in low twin braids, pink barrette on her left, body proportions, all poses and sheet layout, clothing and small heart pattern. Keep all eight views, glasses only in the thinking portrait. Reduce photographic facial shading and individual hair microdetail to the restrained illustrated simplification of image 2, without making her eyes big or turning her into a generic toddler. Fine irregular warm dark brown pencil contours, visible colored pencil strokes, thin soft watercolor washes, gentle rosy cheek and hand warmth, very dark brown hair drawn with tactile overlapping strokes and paper gaps, minimal shadows. Off-white sweatshirt with sparse tiny muted pink, sage and charcoal hearts, charcoal leggings, ivory sneakers, small pink barrette. Natural warm peach skin; restrained palette, enough contrast to read expressions. Natural light ivory paper and clean negative space exactly like image 2. Warm gentle everyday humanity, not a sepia filter, not glossy anime, not photorealism, not vector art. No text, labels, watermarks, backgrounds or added characters. One landscape reusable character sheet.
